title.zh: 将保和省塔比拉兰市Celestino Gallares纪念医院床位由200张增至225张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Celestino Gallares Memorial Hospital in Tagbilaran City, Province of Bohol, From Two Hundred (200) to Two Hundred Twenty-five (225) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Celestino Gallares Memorial Hospital in Tagbilaran City, Province of Bohol, From Two Hundred (200) to Two Hundred Twenty-five (225) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Tưởng niệm Celestino Gallares tại Tỉnh Bohol từ 200 lên 225 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Celestino Gallares ในจังหวัด Bohol จาก 200 เป็น 225 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Memorial Celestino Gallares di Provinsi Bohol dari 200 menjadi 225 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Memorial Celestino Gallares di Wilayah Bohol daripada 200 kepada 225 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7266_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Celestino Gallares Memorial Hospital in Tagbilaran City, Province of Bohol, is hereby increased from two hundred (200) to two hundred twenty-five (225) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
